title: Historical automated-backlog depth remediation: measurement companion

scope.included: Automated atom-derived problem mining, research, optioning, planning, shadow qualification, export readiness, and outcome tracking.
scope.excluded: IDEA and other externally originated work as sources of new automated cases.
scope.primary_objective: Mine real unactioned problems, establish their causal mechanisms, plan solutions that close those mechanisms, and prove the original problems were resolved.

interpretation.single_blended_score_reason: Mining coverage, offline contract tests, live model validity, shadow qualification, and real outcome resolution are different evidence layers. Combining them would conceal the current live failures.
interpretation.unknown_policy: Unknown and not-measured values are not converted to zero percent.

stage1.interpretation: Recall stayed at 100 percent across all four samples. Precision and specificity fluctuated downward, and a0 produced the most definite false candidate cases. This is not monotonic improvement.

stage2.interpretation: Selection was not selective and ranking was false-first. Because benchmark labels were held out until after prioritization, this measures the result rather than an input available to the model.

attempt_accounting.manual_attribution_limit: The artifacts do not contain initiated_by=manual. Manual attribution comes from operator context and is not independently proven by the files.

same_author_repair.interpretation: Two old errors becoming one new error is still progress; error identity need not remain constant. Restart occurred only after three no-improvement repairs at four errors, including an exact repeat.

fresh_author.semantic_observation: The live environment did not reproduce the historical Windows sandbox join failure, and the author did not overclaim resolution. That is directionally appropriate for a held-out false case.

subscription_and_capacity.limit_message: You've hit your usage limit; the artifact says to try again at Jul 18th, 2026 2:33 AM but provides no timezone.
subscription_and_capacity.interpretation: The subscription limit is an external capacity blocker. Repeatedly treating the same systemic limit as repair or fresh-author work created 134.556 seconds of internal retry churn and should become a terminal pause condition, not evidence that research quality regressed.

what_is_not_proven: That mining precision is adequate: the latest definite atom precision was 15.152 percent, and 18 of 24 candidate cases were definite false cases.
That prioritization directs scarce research capacity toward real problems: the first six candidates were definite false and the first actionable candidate ranked seventh.
That the sealed pipeline can produce even one contract-valid, evidence-verified, accepted causal dossier or code-grounded plan.
That the measured mining behavior generalizes beyond the reused development/regression corpus; no fresh separately sealed evaluation corpus has been run.
That deptry is clean across all projects: it passed 13 of 14, with an unchanged backlog_repo DEP002 baseline finding for run_artifacts.
That current uncommitted fixes work in a live model-dependent backlog pipeline; the successful post-restart probe was deliberately trivial and was not an exact-revision sealed qualification.
That two consecutive completed qualification cycles can produce well-researched, code-grounded ready plans.
That a regenerated backlog can be implemented and its original problems resolved.
Any aggregate historical or new-contract solve rate.
next_decisive_measurements: Run a new exact-revision sealed qualification with the signed-in subscription route and remeasure atom recall, atom precision, case mix, prioritization order, self-repair convergence, and accepted-dossier throughput.
Build and run a fresh, separately sealed evaluation corpus before using the development/regression scores as evidence of generalization.
Run two consecutive completed export-disabled qualification cycles and inspect their cases, evidence, plans, and case-graph stability.
Only then reconcile tickets, regenerate, implement, replay original scenarios, and record outcomes.

limitations: Percentages are descriptive ratios for their stated denominators, not estimates of future success probability.
The two Stage 3 attempts are retries for one case; they are not two independent cases.

The two shadows ran on different earlier commits and contain model-dependent outputs. Their overall pass states are comparable; every internal count is not necessarily a like-for-like quality measure.
Offline test counts can grow as benchmarks are added. A stable 100 percent pass ratio does not mean the objective is 100 percent complete.

The aggregate multi-hop benchmark records a semantic failure discovered at the July 11 checkpoint even though its assertion then passed; current targeted regressions cover the repaired semantics, and the full runner and 14-project matrix passed.
Sealed Stage 1 atom metrics and candidate-case metrics have different denominators. Five actionable atoms becoming four actionable cases is grouping, not a missing actionable atom.
Raw invocations and logical work units differ where relation review is batched. Likewise, two nested copies of one cumulative Stage 3 repair history represent one effective case history.

The held-out actionability labels were hidden from model stages, but the reused corpus scores informed engineering changes. It is now a development/regression benchmark, not an untouched final evaluation set; a fresh separately sealed corpus is required to assess generalization.
Model outputs are nondeterministic. Four revision samples show direction and variance, not a guarantee of future precision, recall, prioritization, or repair convergence.

Sixteen completed Stage 3 run directories consist of eight substantive authoring invocations and eight completed usage-limit attempts. One additional interrupted setup produced no sampling artifact and is not counted as a failed model call.
The a0 qualification cycle was incomplete, not a completed passing or completed failing cycle. It contributes zero to the required successful consecutive streak of two.
Historical resolution is unknown, not zero. New-contract resolution is not measurable because no qualified cases have completed the lifecycle.

Current uncommitted changes have passed targeted offline regressions, the full runner, the 14-project matrix, Ruff, lock freshness, repository-tool tests, tracked structured parsing, and a CI-equivalent maintenance-image build. Deptry retains one pre-existing backlog_repo finding. Sealed live qualification, ticket regeneration, and the full end-to-end outcome lifecycle remain outstanding.
The a0 prioritization replay is deterministic development evidence over already scored cases. It is not a sealed model run and must not be used as a percentage estimate or generalization claim.

The July 13 post-restart capacity probe proves only that one simple production-wrapper turn currently completes through the signed-in subscription route. It contributes zero qualification cycles and does not measure mining, research, planning, or outcomes.
